name: Reliant Verified WebMCP Agent Gateway
description: Structured Model Context Protocol tools for autonomous AI agents to search verified commercial contractors, compute technical estimates, inspect compliance specs, and dispatch institutional quotes across 9 high-ticket rental and healthcare verticals.

tools.name: search_contractors
tools.description: Search vetted commercial contractors and rental depots across North America by vertical niche, city, state, or keywords.

niche_id.description: Vertical: luxury_restrooms, commercial_cold_storage, heavy_crane_rigging, temporary_power, machinery_moving, aging_in_place, senior_downsizing, wheelchair_vans, senior_care, or all.

city.description: Target metropolitan area (e.g. Atlanta, Dallas, Miami, Los Angeles, Chicago)

tools.name: get_contractor_details
tools.description: Get full profile, licensing verification, insurance status, equipment fleet, and contact details for a specific contractor.

tools.name: estimate_commercial_project
tools.description: Calculate instant technical specifications and budget estimates for luxury restroom trailers, crane picks, cold storage, power generation, or aging-in-place remodeling.

tools.name: request_commercial_quote
tools.description: Submit an institutional RFQ or commercial quote request on behalf of a user. Dispatches inquiry to verified contractors and locks in 15% escrow protection.

tools.name: get_market_benchmarks
tools.description: Query municipal compliance guidelines, OSHA rules, and average commercial equipment rental rates for any US market.

metro_slug.description: Slug of metro guide (e.g. atlanta-ga, dallas-tx)

tools.name: verify_contractor_badge
tools.description: Audit a contractor live verification status, including active $2M liability insurance certificate, state business license, and Verified Trust Score.

tools.name: claim_contractor_profile
tools.description: Initiate ownership claiming of an existing contractor profile by business email.
